sources.title: FortiOS 7.6.8 Release Notes - Upgrade information
sources.note: "Supported upgrade path information is available through the Upgrade Path Tool on the Fortinet Document Library."

published_in_consultable_form.note: Fortinet publishes supported upgrade paths only through the interactive Upgrade Path Tool. Shiftwall does not scrape it and lists no paths: the app opens the official tool in the browser instead.
